name: embed by Laplacian eigenvectors
mechanism: form the graph's Laplacian matrix and place each vertex at the coordinates given by its entries in the eigenvectors of the smallest nonzero eigenvalues

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Spectral layout' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph drawing:
